title: /about and the five seeker articles load every website theme block to draw none

source.ref: Mega pass 2026-11-19, the half PERF-031 left (owner chose 'Yes, update the probe' 2026-11-20)

detail: PERF-031 moved the platform marketing pages onto lib/page-editor/platform-config.tsx but left /about, /how-to-start-a-circle, /how-to-build-community, /loneliness, /friendship-as-an-adult and /how-to-be-more-social on the full library because scripts/probes/marketing-seo-current.mjs loads those route modules with a fixed dependency map. The owner approved the probe edit on 2026-11-20. Fix: each page renders with platformConfig, imports its own template module (templates/<slug>.ts) instead of getTemplate from templates/index.ts (which imports the whole config), and takes isWellFormed from templates/well-formed.ts. The probe's map gains the three new specifiers, mapped to the same stand-ins as before; every assertion is unchanged and all three modes pass. platform-config.test.ts already pins that the platform set draws every block in these six templates.

verify.note: Fails on main: all six pages reach lib/page-editor/config.tsx. Passes when none reaches it or a site-kit block and each renders with platformConfig.
